operating_rules: One functional acceptance batch at a time;independent streams are a queue,not automatically delegated agents.
Start by selecting an unclosed original acceptance scenario,its production boundary and its exact evidence requirement.
Continue to full criterion acceptance or a concrete recorded blocker;do not deliver a helper-only intermediate ZIP.
A blocker record identifies criterion,scenario,code/evidence/target gap,exact artifact or environment needed,unblocked next action and retained failed/skipped evidence.
Reuse source-identical accepted proofs;run affected tests only after a boundary change,then the relevant existing security gates.
After the user commits,inspect ordinary Quality/SAST;no remote dispatch or broad unchanged rerun in this task.
Every user-facing status/final includes verified/42 and RC percent;promote only original fully satisfied criteria with linked evidence.
If no criterion closes,report percent unchanged and what prevents closure;do not estimate full-product completion or remaining iteration counts.
